reuse.why: Introduces one isWeekendOrHoliday predicate and swaps it into every existing weekend check (firstWeekdayOccurrence, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) while extending the existing helpers.

duplication.why: The holiday rule is defined once, but the pre-existing inline daily-skip branches in getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange each receive the same holiday edit and the search windows (7, 14, 366) are separate magic bounds.

placement.why: The predicate and the generalised shift live in shared/schedules.ts; server callers just forward config.holidays.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, its type field, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clean shared predicate, though callers must remember to forward holidays and the daily-skip decision still lives in three places with uncoordinated look-ahead bounds.

one_place.where: Whether a day is skipped is decided by isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts, which getNextDate (via firstWeekdayOccurrence and getDateWithSkippedWeekend), getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all use.
